article: Check whether an iPhone is carrier-locked
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared every factual instruction and caveat with Apple Support, checked regional Settings terminology, the SIM PIN distinction, metadata and all Apple links.
findings: Updated lastmod to the review date in all 13 editions, preserving the original publication date (2024-09-12).
Confirmed the Settings > General > About path and the “No SIM restrictions” status using Apple Support; the article correctly says only the current carrier can unlock an iPhone.
Confirmed that carrier lock is distinct from a SIM PIN lock, and retained cautions about network compatibility, service eligibility and eSIM.
Checked localized wording and explained that iOS Settings labels vary by language and version.
